scope_guards: The 15 units are retained once and the March and September events are one application chronology.
Sui Generis temporary accommodation is not silently converted into general C3 market-housing capacity.
The March withdrawal is not refusal and the September return is not a second 15-unit scheme.
The September committee resolution was subject to a Unilateral Undertaking and conditions and is not treated as a final issued notice without direct evidence.
Consultation letters, objections, petition signatures and project responses are engagement evidence rather than additional homes.
A 2020 project page does not prove a current 2026 permission, commencement or completion event.
Site naming and committee plans are not exact current HMLR title topology.
No score or promotion is written without current finality, exact geometry, title relation and executed overlays.
